objects.name: Analytic 1838
objects.description: For Android, detect Compromise Client Software Binary from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate File Metadata via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: file hash changes for binary at $SystemBinaryPaths$ relative to known-good baseline — hash deviation confirms modification]; File Modification via Application Vetting / Forensic Acquisition [Dynamic filesystem trace or acquired app-container/filesystem artifacts: write() to path IN $SystemBinaryPaths$ by process NOT IN $TrustedUpdateSources$]; Process Creation via Application Vetting / Managed Device Telemetry [execve() of modified binary (hash != baseline) — execution of modified binary is the persistence activation]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
